mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate, defined as a 0.5pp rise over 3 months, signals a rapidly weakening labor market that will pressure consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production, defined as a 2% y-o-y drop in the industrial production index, signals a weakening supply-side economy that will pressure corporate earnings and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y INDPRO growth falls by > 2% but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: An inverted yield curve, defined as the 10-year Treasury yield falling below the federal funds rate, signals an impending recession that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: GS10 < FEDFUNDS but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid rise in the consumer price index, defined as a 3% y-o-y increase in CPI, signals rising inflation expectations that will drive the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL y-o-y growth > 3% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in payroll employment, defined as a 200k decline in PAYEMS over 1 month, signals a rapidly weakening labor market that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS declines > 200k in 1 month but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A collapse in housing starts, defined as a 20% y-o-y decline in HOUST, signals a severe demand slowdown that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y HOUST growth falls by > 20% but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the real federal funds rate, defined as FEDFUNDS rising above the y-o-y CPI growth rate, signals a tightening of financial conditions that will pressure corporate borrowing costs and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > CPIAUCSL y-o-y growth but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive > 60% of the time.
